title: Apply per-scope cost budget to memory extraction
requirements: Default background extraction admits at most two jobs per conversation scope per rolling minute in addition to existing single-flight and shared concurrency protections.
Admission budget is independent across groups and private users, recovers after the window, and is charged for failed provider work without charging ineligible or already-pending requests.
Keep existing extraction cursor, message-count triggers, compaction, cancellation and shutdown behavior; document remaining live validation separately from completed local development.
